name: Marmitt's Ray-Cell Intersection
definition: Performing ray-cell intersection to compute the point on the isosurface, using the Marmitt et al. 03 method.
summary: Marmitt's Ray-Cell Intersection is a numerically stable, single-precision method for finding ray-isosurface intersections in voxel cells, distinguished by its speed and iterative bisection refinement over analytical solvers.
